'''Zul'Hazu''' is a large jungle troll settlement in [[Lapidis Isle]]. It is the territory of the [[Hazzuri tribe]], and their leaders [[Chieftain Woh'zo]], [[Champion Raggazi]] and [[Darkmaster Haza'gi]] can be found here.
